description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars, which implements methods related to retrieving template variables in the Smarty templating engine. It provides functions to get all or specific template variables, and to access individual variable objects.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_GetTemplateVars
classes.description: Class providing methods to retrieve template variables within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: getTemplateVars
methods.description: Retrieves either a single specified template variable or all template variables, optionally including parent templates and global variables.

methods.name: _getVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the object of a Smarty variable by name, searching through template hierarchy and global variables.
